mapper.select: SELECT oa.organization_id, oa.authority_id, oa.granted_at, oa.granted_by, oa.notes, a.name AS authority_name, a.description AS authority_description, a.category_id AS authority_category_id, c.name AS authority_category_name, c.description AS authority_category_description FROM organization_authority oa INNER JOIN authority a ON oa.authority_id = a.id INNER JOIN category c ON a.category_id = c.id WHERE oa.organization_id = #{organizationId} ORDER BY oa.granted_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO organization_authority (organization_id, authority_id, granted_at, granted_by, notes) VALUES ( #{organizationId}, #{authorityId}, #{grantedAt}, #{grantedBy}, #{notes} )
mapper.select: SELECT a.name FROM organization_authority oa INNER JOIN authority a ON oa.authority_id = a.id WHERE oa.organization_id = #{organizationId} ORDER BY a.name
